testing_requirements.data_testid_rule: ALL interactive components, filter buttons, catalog search inputs, evaluator inputs, add to cart buttons, and cart totals MUST have explicit kebab-case data-testid attributes.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Maintain strict high-end e-commerce aesthetic with off-white (#FBFBF9) background and crisp obsidian text.
2. Ensure header features the SVG logo mark for Ahorramix and visible desktop navigation.
3. Implement Lenis smooth scroll and Framer Motion staggered reveals for hero typography and bento grids.

4. Include 'Evaluador de productos' with live calculation of net margin, ROI %, viability score, and CSV export format matching WooCommerce standard headers (ID, Name, Regular Price, Sale Price, SKU, Categories, Stock).
5. Ensure cart drawer + full page cart work seamlessly with local state and clear checkout CTA.
6. Include a Hostinger static export banner / modal guiding how to build `npm run build` and upload to Hostinger hPanel + connecting WooCommerce REST API.
